status.on.winter: Until the end of February, then the snow waits for December.
status.on.always: All year round, because "Only in winter" is off.
status.waiting.about: The snow starts by itself on December 1 and stops at the end of February. To see it now, turn off "Only in winter".
settings.winter_only.about: December to February. Turn it off to have snow right now and all year.
settings.wind.about: A light breeze carries the flakes a little to the side.
settings.about: The snow does not get in the way: clicks go through it. It pauses while the window is in the background.
